prompts.luna_izq: Moonlit night scene. Everything is bathed in cold blue moonlight coming from the right: silver-blue rim light on the ridges, deep navy-blue shadows in every gully, strong blue color grading, local colors desaturated by the moonlight, very dark sky with a few stars. The landscape covers the whole mountain from base to summit. Treat the mountain as one continuous surface texture: vegetation only as low ground cover or as a continuous canopy seen from above, no isolated tall trees, no tall cacti, no poles, no vertical objects, no buildings. Ibera wetlands of Corrientes: marshes and lagoons reflecting the sky, floating camalote plants and low reeds covering the slopes, patterns of water channels.
